nameEn: Manufacture of other products of wood; manufacture of articles of cork, straw and plaiting materials
description: This class includes the manufacture of other wood products and articles of cork, straw and plaiting materials not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of wooden tool handles, bodies and frames
manufacture of wooden broom and brush handles
manufacture of wooden shoe lasts and trees
manufacture of wooden household utensils and kitchen articles
manufacture of wooden statuettes, ornaments, inlaid wood
manufacture of natural cork products: corks, stoppers, insulation boards
manufacture of plaiting materials: mats, matting, screens of bamboo, rattan and similar
